summary: ITER68 full-stack verification of (1) Reduce-motion accessibility toggle + backend rider-settings whitelist and (2) new /scenic-destinations Explore Destinations screen. BACKEND: 12/12 pytest tests PASS (/app/backend/tests/test_iter68_reduce_motion_and_scenic_destinations.py, junit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter68.xml) — PUT /api/rider/settings round-trips reduceMotion (true & false), the a11y triple {largeText,highContrast,reduceMotion} round-trips together and does NOT clobber sibling fields (homeCity, hudEnabled), MongoDB _id is stripped, both GET+PUT are auth-gated (401 without token), /api/scenic/routes returns 22 published routes with region metadata, 'garda' → ≥1, 'kenya' → Hell's Gate, and /api/scenic/routes/lake-garda is playable. FRONTEND (as greenlantern@roujaune.app @ 1280x800): /scenic-destinations renders with testID scenic-destinations, 22 destination-card-* tiles, all 5 chips destinations-region-{All,Alps,Lakes,Safari,Countryside}, scenic-search input, scenic-search-clear button and destinations-empty state. Search works perfectly: 'garda' filters to 4 (lake-garda, adige-valley-to-garda, ledro-to-garda-ponale, garda-sunrise-promenade), 'kenya' filters to 1 (hells-gate-safari), 'nonexistentplace123' shows the empty state with 'No rides match "…"' + Clear filters CTA, clear restores 22. Card tap correctly navigates to /scenic-ride?route=lake-garda. Settings → Accessibility card renders all three toggles tg-largeText, tg-highContrast, tg-reduceMotion; toggling tg-reduceMotion PUTs to /api/rider/settings and the value survives full page reload. REGRESSION: scenic-ride player at /scenic-ride?route=lake-garda still loads with the YouTube iframe. HOWEVER one CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG was found: the region filter chips do NOT filter the grid when clicked alone — clicking destinations-region-Alps / Lakes / Safari / Countryside leaves all 22 cards visible and the 'All' chip stays selected (state does not switch). Combining region + search returned the same result as search alone (Alps+'lake' = 7 = number of 'lake' matches with no region filter applied), confirming the region state never updates from a chip tap. This blocks the region-filter acceptance criterion.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping destinations-region-{Alps|Lakes|Safari|Countryside} does NOT filter the grid — result count stays at 22 and the 'All' chip remains highlighted after the click. Only combined with search does the grid narrow (because the search predicate runs), which proves the `region` React state never updates from a chip tap. Reference: /app/frontend/app/scenic-destinations.tsx:94-107 (ScrollView chips with Pressable onPress={() => setRegion(r)}).

issues: '22 rides' count text visually overlaps the region-chip ScrollView row on desktop (1280x800) — the count sits on top of the chip labels, which is likely also the cause of the region filter click not registering. Reference: styles.count (marginBottom: 12) is inside the inner ScrollView, but the outer horizontal filter ScrollView appears to render behind it. Refer /app/frontend/app/scenic-destinations.tsx:120-127 vs 94-107.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (noted in iter66/iter67) — console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still fires. Non-blocking, not introduced by iter68.

action_items: FIX region filter click handling on /scenic-destinations: clicking destinations-region-Alps/Lakes/Safari/Countryside must update the `region` state so the grid re-filters. Likely root cause: the horizontal filter ScrollView is being visually + hit-test overlapped by the 'count' text of the sibling ScrollView (they render in the same vertical band). Two possible fixes: (a) move the '{n} rides' count inside the horizontal filter ScrollView's parent as a preceding sibling (before the filter row) or after with a proper marginTop, so the chips row has its own layout band; (b) wrap the chip ScrollView with an explicit height container so its Pressables receive touches. Verify by asserting `destinations-region-Alps` selection toggles chip highlight AND grid count drops below 22.

OPTIONAL: consider adding a small `flex-shrink: 0` container around the horizontal ScrollView and/or increasing paddingTop on styles.scroll so the count/grid doesn't sit on top of the filter row on wider layouts (>=1000px).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/routes/rider.py PUT /api/rider/settings correctly whitelists arbitrary body keys except id/user_id/_id — reduceMotion flows through with zero backend changes required. GET returns {} on first read (no doc) which the frontend a11y hydrator handles gracefully.

/app/frontend/src/lib/a11y.ts: setReduceMotion → setState → persist() correctly writes to AsyncStorage AND PUTs {largeText, highContrast, reduceMotion} to /api/rider/settings — clean and consistent with existing setLargeText / setHighContrast. resetA11y() on logout prevents leakage across accounts. refreshA11yFromServer is called after hydrate and coerces booleans safely. Good.
/app/frontend/src/lib/use-reduced-motion.ts correctly ORs the app toggle with the OS AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled, matching platform conventions.

/app/frontend/app/scenic-destinations.tsx: search predicate correctly ORs name/place/country/tag and combines with region. Cards have testID destination-card-<id>, chips have testID destinations-region-<r>, empty state has testID destinations-empty and a Clear-filters CTA that resets both filters. Region ordering (Alps/Lakes/Safari/Countryside first, alphabetical after) is thoughtful. NOTE: the two sibling ScrollViews (filterRow horizontal + scroll vertical) can visually collide on desktop — recommend restructuring, see action_items.

success_rate.frontend: 80% — scenic-destinations screen renders, search+empty+clear+card-tap all work, reduce-motion toggle + persistence works; region filter chips are broken (see ui_bugs)

seed_data_creation: None — tests use the existing published scenic catalog and the rider greenlantern@roujaune.app. Test PUT reduce-motion writes are cleaned up (toggled back off) at the end of the a11y bundle test.
